svg.title: Independent Tunability
svg.desc: One fixed curvature profile accompanies three independently selected loop phases. Source relation: \partial_aF=0,\qquad \mathrm{Hol}_{\mathcal{A}_a}(\ell)=e^{-2\pi aC_1}. The explicit SO(2) connection family in the source. Curvature and phase use distinct graphical coordinates.
svg.text: of Local Curvature and Global Holonomy
